interface.name: winehua_toplevel
interface.description:
Vendor protocol between Wine's wayland driver and the WineHua compositor.
Base xdg-shell cannot express Win32 modal dialog relations (an owned popup whose owner is disabled), so Wine reports them here; the compositor uses the relation to keep the dialog above its owner and to block input routed to a disabled owner window.

request.name: set_modal

description.summary: Set or clear the modal relation of a toplevel

request.description: surface: the dialog toplevel; owner_surface: its owner toplevel (NULL when clearing); modal: 1 = apply, 0 = release.
